_about: GENERATED by .claude/atlas-build/build-war-extents.js — never edit. Rows of the war extents derived from open sources (see that script's header): [from, to, rings] per extent key, rings as flat lon/lat lists (holes nest by depth). build-history.js reads it in place of the card's own authored ring for these keys and checks every source hash against sources.json.

ext_western_confederacy.note: The Confederacy’s ground is the card’s own authored limit of the Ohio country less the cessions the Royce Schedule dates by the end of each year (USFS digitisation of Royce 1899, public domain): the outer limit is Folio’s, the cuts are Royce’s.

ext_messenia.note: Messenia is the part of OpenHistoricalMap’s Lacedaemon polygon (relation 2849727, CC0; its own tags say “needs source for boundary lines”) that lies inside the Taygetos line Folio drew on the card: the outer limit is OHM’s, the line is Folio’s.

ext_sparta.note: Sparta (Laconia) is OpenHistoricalMap’s Lacedaemon polygon (relation 2849727, CC0; its own tags say “needs source for boundary lines”) outside the Taygetos line Folio drew on the card: the outer limit is OHM’s, the line is Folio’s.
